sources.name: Companies House — Find and update company information
sources.verdict: The national register; free REST API behind it (dev hub verified live). Backbone for every UK entity record; effectively unlimited yield.

sources.name: Companies House REST API (developer hub)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Free key, company profiles, officers, filings, charges, PSC; rate-limited 600 req/5min. Primary deterministic ingest route.

sources.name: Companies House Streaming API
sources.verdict: Real-time push of register changes (companies, filings, officers, PSC, charges, insolvency). Documented on the verified dev hub; ideal change-detection feed.

sources.name: Companies House Free Company Data Product (monthly bulk snapshot)
sources.verdict: Verified: ~470MB CSV ZIP of all live companies, refreshed within 5 working days of month end. $0 full-universe seed.

sources.name: Companies House PSC (persons with significant control) bulk snapshot
sources.verdict: Daily JSON snapshot of beneficial-ownership (PSC) data — the UK is the rare jurisdiction where UBO data is genuinely open. URL follows verified download-site pattern; snapshot page itself not individually fetched.

sources.name: Companies House Accounts Monthly Data (iXBRL bulk)
sources.verdict: Bulk iXBRL company accounts as filed — deterministic financials for portfolio companies, lenders, servicers. Same verified download host; page not individually fetched.

sources.name: FCA Financial Services Register
sources.verdict: The register of all authorised firms incl. AIFMs, MiFID firms, fund managers, payment/credit firms. Salesforce UI is JS-heavy (developer page returned empty to fetch) but the Register API is real and free-keyed at register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/ — sign up for key; high yield.

sources.name: FCA Data portal + National Storage Mechanism (regulated filings)
sources.verdict: NSM holds prospectuses, annual reports and regulated disclosures of listed issuers; searchable index. Not fetch-verified this run; known-official FCA property.

sources.name: FCA Cryptoasset (MLR) register
sources.verdict: UK equivalent of a MiCA register (UK is outside MiCA): FCA-registered cryptoasset firms. Same Salesforce register — reachable via the Register API rather than the JS UI.

sources.name: FCA Mutuals Public Register
sources.verdict: Registered societies, credit unions, friendly societies (niche LP/lender side). Not fetch-verified; long-standing FCA subdomain.

sources.name: Bank of England / PRA — lists of authorised banks and insurers
sources.verdict: BoE publishes monthly 'List of banks' and insurer lists (PDF/XLS). Site returned 403 to automated fetch — expect bot-protection; manual/headed retrieval or the monthly PDFs are the route.

sources.name: The Pensions Regulator (TPR)
sources.verdict: Press page fetch-verified (no RSS). Publishes list of authorised DC master trusts and DB landscape data — the UK LP side's regulator. Scheme-level register not fully public.

sources.name: Pension Protection Fund (Purple Book / PPF 7800)
sources.verdict: Annual Purple Book + monthly PPF 7800 index: aggregate DB pension universe data (LP-side context). Not fetch-verified this run; well-known official publications.

sources.name: Charity Commission Register of Charities (+ API and full extract)
sources.verdict: Public API and full data download of all E&W charities incl. endowments/foundations — a genuine LP-side source. Not fetch-verified this run; official service.

sources.name: FRC — UK Audit Register (statutory auditors)
sources.verdict: FRC oversees the register of statutory audit firms (fund auditors — service graph cat. 6). Register access route not verified this run.

sources.name: The Gazette (London/Edinburgh/Belfast) — official gazette + Linked Data API
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified: free Linked Data API (JSON-LD/XML/RDF) + SPARQL, docs on github.com/TheGazette; insolvency notices from 1998. Paid bulk data service exists; free API under fair-use is the route. High yield for insolvency/NPL signals.

sources.name: Insolvency Service (gov.uk)
sources.verdict: Atom feed fetch-verified and active (director disqualifications, IP sanctions, statistics). Monthly insolvency statistics downloadable. Strong distressed/credit signal source.

sources.name: Individual Insolvency Register
sources.verdict: Official search of bankruptcies/IVAs. Personal data — use only for insolvency-practitioner/case context, not individual harvesting. Machine route unverified.

sources.name: Find an Insolvency Practitioner (Insolvency Service directory)
sources.verdict: Official IP roll (category 2 entity type). URL is the canonical gov.uk slug; not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Find Case Law — The National Archives (court judgments)
sources.verdict: Open judgments incl. Insolvency and Companies Court, with Atom feeds and a documented open API. Not fetch-verified this run; official service. Good for litigation-funding and distressed coverage.

sources.name: London Stock Exchange — issuer reports and lists
sources.verdict: Fetch returned title only — heavy JS app. Issuer/instrument lists exist as XLS downloads behind the app; headed browser or the FCA NSM/Investegate are better machine routes.

sources.name: Investegate — free RNS regulatory announcements aggregator
sources.verdict: FE fundinfo's free full-text RNS archive with clean per-company indexes — the practical machine route to LSE disclosures. Not fetch-verified this run; long-established.

sources.name: Aquis Stock Exchange (AQSE) — issuer list and announcements
sources.verdict: Growth-market issuers outside LSE. URL not fetch-verified; modest but distinct yield.

sources.name: UK Private Capital (formerly BVCA) — member directory
sources.verdict: Verified via search: BVCA renamed UK Private Capital (Jan 2026); ~600 member firms. Quick-search is public; full directory is paid — use public tier only, names then resolved via Companies House/FCA.

sources.name: The Investment Association (IA)
sources.verdict: UK asset-management trade body (ManCos, liquid alts adjacents). Old members-page path 404s — member list location must be re-found; do not count on it until located.

sources.name: AIMA — Alternative Investment Management Association
sources.verdict: Global hedge-fund/private-credit body HQ'd in London; member visibility is partial/paid. Not fetch-verified; treat as context, resolve entities via FCA register.

sources.name: UK Finance — member list (banking association)
sources.verdict: Banking/finance trade association ~300 members. URL pattern not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Finance & Leasing Association (FLA) members
sources.verdict: Leasing, asset finance and consumer credit lenders (ABL/specialty-finance side). Member list location unverified.

sources.name: Association of British Insurers (ABI) members
sources.verdict: Insurer LP-side and ILS-adjacent entities. Not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: PLSA — Pensions and Lifetime Savings Association
sources.verdict: Pension-fund trade body (LP side); member visibility limited. Context source, unverified.

sources.name: British Business Bank (DFI)
sources.verdict: National development bank; publishes delivery-partner lists and LP commitments to UK VC/growth funds (e.g. £55.6m to Highland Europe seen in press this week). Site not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: National Wealth Fund (ex UK Infrastructure Bank)
sources.verdict: State infrastructure/transition investor — deal announcements are entity+signal gold for real assets. URL not fetch-verified.

sources.name: UKRI Gateway to Research (GtR) API
sources.verdict: Open API over all UKRI/Innovate UK grants incl. company recipients — deterministic early-stage/venture-adjacent entity source. Not fetch-verified this run; documented public API.

sources.name: Find a Tender Service (FTS) — UK above-threshold procurement
sources.verdict: OCDS-format API for UK high-value procurement (infrastructure concessionaires, EPC, advisors). Official service; API documented, not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Contracts Finder — below-threshold procurement
sources.verdict: Companion OCDS API for smaller public contracts. Official; not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: UK Emissions Trading Registry — participant/account reports
sources.verdict: UK ETS (post-Brexit equivalent of EU ETS national accounts): account-holder and compliance reports published on gov.uk. Exact publication slug should be confirmed at ingest; gov.uk publication pattern is reliable.

sources.name: UK Land Carbon Registry (Woodland Carbon Code / Peatland Code)
sources.verdict: Public registry of UK voluntary carbon projects and unit holders (niche-alts cat. 5). Hosted registry (S&P Global Environmental Registry); machine route unverified.

sources.name: RICS — Find a Member / regulated-firm directory
sources.verdict: Accredited valuers/appraisers (real-assets service graph). Directory exists but is search-form based; machine route unverified — expect JS.

sources.name: Solicitors Regulation Authority — check a solicitor/firm
sources.verdict: Register of all E&W law firms and solicitors (fund-structuring/M&A law firms, cat. 6). SRA has offered a data feed historically; route unverified this run.

sources.name: The Law Society — Find a Solicitor
sources.verdict: Complementary public directory with practice-area facets. Not fetch-verified; likely JS search.

sources.name: The Takeover Panel — disclosure table and documents
sources.verdict: Live offer disclosure table = authoritative UK public-M&A deal flow (PE take-privates). Simple HTML site historically; not re-verified this run.

sources.name: British Property Federation members
sources.verdict: Real-estate industry body (developers, REITs, RE fund managers). Member list location unverified.

sources.name: UKBAA — UK Business Angels Association directory
sources.verdict: Angel groups and early-stage funds directory. Unverified; moderate yield.

sources.name: Financial Times
sources.verdict: The UK business daily of record; hard paywall but RSS gives headlines+links (feed URL well-known, not re-verified this run). Headline+link ingest only per compliance rules.

sources.name: City AM
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working RSS 2.0, hourly updates, free access. Strong City/markets/IPO coverage.

sources.name: The Guardian — Business
sources.verdict: Free, reliable section RSS (Guardian feed infrastructure is stable; this feed not re-verified this run).

sources.name: BBC News — Business
sources.verdict: Free national coverage; long-stable RSS (not re-verified this run).

sources.name: Sky News — Business
sources.verdict: Mark Kleinman's City scoops make this disproportionately valuable for UK deal signals. Feed URL long-established, not re-verified this run.

sources.name: Sifted
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working feed, updated daily; FT-backed European startup/VC coverage with strong UK weighting. Partial paywall.

sources.name: UKTN (UK Tech News)
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working feed, hourly; UK funding rounds and weekly deal roundups. Free.

sources.name: Hedgeweek
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working feed; daily hedge-fund/liquid-alts coverage. Free with registration prompts.

sources.name: Private Equity Wire
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working feed; daily PE/private-credit deal and fund news incl. UK-specific items.

sources.name: Institutional Asset Manager
sources.verdict: Sister title to Hedgeweek/PE Wire (same publisher, same WordPress stack — /feed/ very likely works but was not verified this run). Asset-management/LP coverage.

sources.name: Finextra
sources.verdict: Fintech/banking-infrastructure news; long-established RSS endpoint (not re-verified this run). Free.

sources.name: Investment Week
sources.verdict: UK fund-industry trade title (Incisive/Arena). Registration-walled; RSS status unverified.

sources.name: Financial News (FN London)
sources.verdict: Dow Jones City title — asset management, IB, PE people moves. Hard paywall; headline monitoring only; RSS unverified.

sources.name: Private Equity News
sources.verdict: Dow Jones UK/European PE title. Hard paywall; headline-only value; RSS unverified.

sources.name: Pensions Expert (FT Specialist)
sources.verdict: UK pension-scheme (LP-side) trade coverage. Paywalled; RSS unverified.

sources.name: IPE — Investment & Pensions Europe
sources.verdict: Pan-European institutional-investor coverage with strong UK LP reporting. /feed returned 404 — no working RSS found; registration wall. Headline monitoring via site only.

sources.name: Property Week
sources.verdict: Leading UK real-estate trade title (EG having closed). Paywalled; RSS unverified.

sources.name: CoStar News UK
sources.verdict: Free-to-read UK commercial-real-estate news desk (absorbed much ex-EG readership). Machine route unverified.

sources.name: FCA — news and press releases
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working RSS: enforcement, authorisation policy, firm failures (e.g. Blue Motor Finance administration). High-signal regulator feed.

sources.name: Bank of England — news
sources.verdict: Site 403s automated fetch. BoE historically exposes RSS under /rss — needs a headed retry; until then treat as blocked.

sources.name: HM Treasury (gov.uk)
sources.verdict: Fetch-verified working Atom feed (Budget dates, pension-capital policy). The gov.uk .atom pattern works for every department.

sources.name: Department for Business and Trade (gov.uk)
sources.verdict: Investment-promotion and industrial-policy announcements via the verified gov.uk Atom pattern (this specific org feed not individually fetched).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deepest global alt-funds coverage — UK GPs, LPs, fund performance, dry powder; strong on pensions/insurers as LPs.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FCA Financial Services Register (AIFM/manager authorisations), Companies House accounts of fund GPs/LLPs (UK LLP accounts disclose carry vehicles), local-authority pension fund FOI/committee papers, LSE/RNS disclosures — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: UK M&A/PE/VC deal coverage, valuations, service-provider league tables.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Companies House filings (SH01 share allotments, charges), RNS announcements via LSE, The Gazette insolvency notices, press releases — the SH01/charges route is fully open via CH API.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong UK/European startup and VC round coverage; powers several UK government/ecosystem reports.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Companies House incorporations and filings, press/funding announcements, accelerator and university spinout lists, Innovate UK/UKRI grant data (GtR API).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow UK startup coverage; self-reported plus press.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and startup-media announcements (Sifted/UKTN-type sources we ingest directly); little registry depth.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The key UK-native competitor: tracks every UK high-growth company incl. UNANNOUNCED equity rounds, at 8-figure company coverage.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Their visible moat is systematic parsing of Companies House filings — SH01 (allotment of shares) forms reveal fundraises never press-released, plus PSC data, accounts and The Gazette. Every one of those inputs is free via the CH API/bulk products; this is the single most instructive public-source blueprint for our UK build.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Hedge fund, private-credit and asset-owner (LP) data; events-driven; strong UK/EU institutional coverage.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FCA register, US SEC ADV filings, pension-scheme annual reports and local-authority committee documents — the UK LGPS committee-paper route is public and underused.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Distressed debt, NPL, restructuring and leveraged-credit intelligence with strong London desk.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: The Gazette insolvency notices, Companies House charge registrations (secured lending events), court lists/Find Case Law, administrators' progress reports filed at CH — all directly ingestible.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Commodity company-data layers over the registry; not alts-specific but show the data plumbing.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Companies House bulk products and streaming API, Gazette feeds, accounts iXBRL — confirming those are the canonical $0 routes.

searchedButAbsent: AltFi is dead — fetch of altfi.com/rss returned a closure announcement ('we are closing the AltFi business'), so the hinted source is removed rather than padded. EG/Estates Gazette (LexisNexis) ceased publication, so it is excluded despite being the historic RE trade paper. No working RSS found for IPE (/feed 404s) or for The Pensions Regulator/BoE (BoE 403s bots). No free machine-readable LSE issuer list — the reports page is a JS app returning only a title; Investegate + FCA NSM are the workaround. The Investment Association's members page has moved (old path 404s) and was not relocated this run. Peel Hunt research (hinted) is not public — broker research sits behind MiFID walls (Research Tree is paid), so no entry was made. BVCA's own domain now 301s to ukprivatecapital.co.uk and the full member directory is paid; only the public quick-search tier is catalogued. UK note contra the usual EU rule: PSC (UBO) data IS genuinely public here via Companies House bulk — an exception worth exploiting, not assuming elsewhere.
